title: The large $N$ vector model with angular velocity
summary: We study the free energy of a critical vector model at large $N$ on $S^{1}\times S^{2}$ with an angular velocity $\hatμ$ without the singlet constraint. We study the model for which the large $N$ dynamics is controlled by the uniform saddle point of the auxiliary field arising in the Hubbard-Stratanovich transformation. The leading high-temperature behaviour is determined analytically both as an expansion about $\hatμr=0$ and $\hatμ^{2}r^{2}=1$ where $r$ is the radius of the sphere. We supplement the analytic results with a numerical analysis that agrees with both the analytical expansions…
